A line-break-only emphasis nested inside an otherwise empty strong wrapper still separates the words on either side

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
